# Iris dataset (test data)

The `iris.json` file in this directory is a JSON-formatted version of the
Iris dataset prepared for testing and benchmarking purposes.

## Source / Attribution

- R. A. Fisher, "The use of multiple measurements in taxonomic problems",
  Annals of Eugenics, 7(2):179–188 (1936).
- UCI Machine Learning Repository: "Iris Data Set" — [https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/53/iris](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/53/iris)
- Formatted by [github.com/etrace-io/sklearn](https://github.com/etrace-io/sklearn)

## Notes and Licenses

- `iris.json` was taken from
  [https://github.com/etrace-io/sklearn/blob/master/datasets/data/iris.json](https://github.com/etrace-io/sklearn/blob/master/datasets/data/iris.json),
  converting the original UCI dataset (CSV) into JSON and adapting it for
  tests under [CC BY 4.0](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/53/iris).
- Please follow the original data source's terms and license when reusing
  the dataset. The copy included here is intended for test use only.
